name: CoorRect
formula: =LAMBDA(h,b,[isRepeatFirstPoint],LET(isRepeat, IF(ISOMITTED(isRepeatFirstPoint), FALSE, isRepeatFirstPoint), xa, -b / 2, ya, h / 2, xb, b / 2, yb, h / 2, xc, b / 2, yc, -h / 2, xd, -b / 2, yd, -h / 2, rowA, HSTACK(xa, ya), rowB, HSTACK(xb, yb), rowC, HSTACK(xc, yc), rowD, HSTACK(xd, yd), output, IF(isRepeat, VSTACK(rowD, rowC, rowB, rowA, rowD), VSTACK(rowD, rowC, rowB, rowA)), output))
